## INDEX.md entry

```text
- **pin-github-actions**: Unpinned GitHub Action detected: a workflow references an action by a tag or branch (owner/repo at a movable ref) rather than a full 40-character commit SHA, a docker:// image has no @sha256: digest, or a line check cannot read the ref (an escape, an open quote, an alias, a value moved off the uses line). Pin it to the lowercase SHA or digest -- keep the version in a trailing comment for readability -- so a re-tagged or compromised release cannot change what runs. Waiver: 'pragma: allowlist unpinned-action' on the same line. A person's commit honours it; in the agent (write, the turn's end, an agent's commit) only a line already in HEAD counts, and the MCP gateway never does. An agent asks a person; it never writes the pragma. Also checked in the agent: before a write, or at the end of the turn, depending on the agent.
```
